error_reason: The Planner erroneously identified Brian Green as the composer, failing to recognize Miley Cyrus and her sister Destiny Hope Cyrus as the actual songwriters. This foundational misinterpretation caused the entire multi-agent run to search for the wrong person (Brian Green instead of Miley Cyrus) and ignore explicit song credits that list the Cyrus sisters as composers.

hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the task by dismissing Miley Cyrus (the primary artist and credited writer/co-composer) in favor of Brian Green. This foundational misinterpretation caused the entire multi-agent run to search for the wrong person (Brian Green instead of Miley Cyrus) and ignore the fact that the song credits explicitly list Destiny Hope Cyrus as a songwriter/composer. Had the Planner correctly identified Miley Cyrus as the primary composer/writer here, the subsequent steps would have correctly identified her father (Billy Ray Cyrus).
